source.title: Named independent Dragonflight random-processing event/denominator source search (no new usable cohort)

notes: Cross-checked fresh name-first original-source searches against existing dragonflight evidence and established source genealogy. Bugy aggregated prospect data appears via several Wowhead item pages/localizations, neoslayyer single-comment diamond samples already in research/v3/evidence/dragonflight/2026-11-01T2032-firsthand-dragonflight-diamond-cohorts.jsonl, and the 2023 Khaz'gorite 20-prospect zero-diamond cohort is already indexed. Forum Prismatic concentration testing supplies no prospect material-output data. No new independent completed-cast 0-N output histogram, output-specific castsWithDrop, net input/Resourcefulness ledger, rank-conditioned material totals or dedupable numerical cohort was found. Unknown results remain null; no copied source counted as new study.
lookingFor: Draconium Ore, Serevite Ore, Khaz'gorite Ore, Prismatic Ore prospecting and Bubble Poppy/Saxifrage milling; original item-ID/rank-separated completed-cast material 0-N histograms, outputs, refund-adjusted denominators, spell/skill epochs
